== BPFK ==

BPFK (baupla fuzykamni, i.e. "Language Planning Committee", also known as '''byfy''') is a standing committee of [[LLG]] with the charge of improving and maintaining formal descriptions of Lojban, elaborating undocumented and under-documented language features, resolving inconsistencies and errors in existing documentation, and responding to issues that arise in usage. Initially [[Official Baseline Statement (2002/2003)|chartered in 2003]], it was reauthorized by the 2014 meeting of the LLG membership, and presented with a [[BPFK Reauthorization|new charter]].
